note: Gaethje talks about his own injuries and possible retirement; Topuria appears in one writer's line as a possible rematch, which is speculation. Centrality: the past fight is not discussed, so only_mentioned rather than one_of_several. Act none_of_these: Gaethje does nothing regarding Topuria, he only speaks of himself.

French article quoting Topuria (translated, plus a truncated English embed of his post) on his mindset after the loss and his wish to return, with no date or opponent. Fact: his intent to come back is talk, not a set event; a reader could call it career news.
Ukrainian fight report: Donchenko beat Soriano at UFC Fight Night 287 in Paris, no quotes, no method given; the closing line about future title fights is the writer's speculation.

Tsarukyan says Topuria vs Pimblett makes sense but the UFC will not book it and will give Ilia 'someone easy'; the writer urges the UFC to book it. Centrality: Topuria and Pimblett share the piece about equally. Act: the closest fit is steering (who he should fight), though Tsarukyan is really forecasting the matchmakers, which no act value covers cleanly.

Ukrainian: welterweight champion Makhachev says he does not consider Amosov dangerous. Source: he is the champion of Amosov's division but no fight between them is booked or announced, so other_fighter; opponent_side is arguable if the title-contender link counts as 'publicly linked'. Amosov's May win over Alvarez is background only.

Gaethje's own injury and layoff news, tied to the Topuria fight: he refuses an immediate rematch, says Topuria has work to do first and guesses Topuria also will not fight until next year. Act: refusing the rematch and saying he must earn it is a steer; assesses_him is arguable. Fact: Topuria's camp wanting a rematch is a wish, and 'probably not until next year' is Gaethje's guess, so no_fact; next_fight/wish is the alternative. Topuria's broken nose and orbitals are recalled as background.

Spanish reporter Alvaro Colmenero says Topuria will return to the public eye in September after July healing and August vacation. Fact none_of_these: the news is a public re-emergence, which is neither health nor a fight; health is the alternative because the piece frames it as him having recovered enough. reports_his_health yes on the same recovery update, but it is thin. The rematch talk and the Pimblett pitch are speculation.

Spanish: manager Malki Kawa replies to Abdelaziz's prediction that Usman Nurmagomedov would beat Topuria, and defends the Gaethje loss as a bad night. Fact: the Usman fight is explicitly only a possibility with no date; the line that his return points to 2027 while he recovers from fractures is a closing aside, so no_fact rather than next_fight/rumour.

Spanish compilation of Topuria's earlier interview quotes (GQ, Charlas Adictivas) about his childhood in Georgia, bullying, fear and family values. Fact: personal_life fits the content, but the quotes are old and the article itself says he has not spoken since the June loss, so no_fact is arguable. The 'next fight' and 'agent picked his rival' lines are related-article links, not content.

Dana White tells Jim Rome that Topuria is ready to fight, nothing is scheduled, and Gaethje or Pimblett are both options. reports_his_health: 'recovery has gone well' is one writer's line, not the news, so no. His social post about his son is mentioned but not quoted.

Donchenko beat Soriano by unanimous decision at UFC Paris and asks for Daniel Rodriguez at the end of the year, preferably five rounds. Fact: the result is the established fact; the Rodriguez fight is his wish, so it does not count as next-fight news, though the headline leads with the callout.

Manager Malki Kawa fires back at Ali Abdelaziz's prediction that Usman Nurmagomedov beats Topuria, says the Gaethje loss was an off night and promises a comeback masterclass. All opinion; a Nurmagomedov fight is only a possibility.

Gaethje says he would rather fight McGregor than rematch Topuria, Oliveira or Holloway. Centrality: Topuria's loss is one background line and the rematch is dismissed in passing; one_of_several is arguable since the article ties Gaethje's plans to the fight they had. Act none_of_these: Gaethje talks about his own preference, not about what Topuria should do; steers_him is the nearest alternative.

Matt Brown, a retired fighter speaking as a podcaster, says an immediate Gaethje rematch could ruin Topuria and he should take a confidence fight (Moicano) first; Jon Anik reportedly said the UFC is exploring the rematch for 2027. Source: Brown is described as a former fighter, so other_fighter is arguable. Fact and next_fight yes rest on the 'exploring' line, which the article itself calls speculative. Injuries are background.

The saved text is only a CSS stylesheet; no article content was captured, so Donchenko appears nowhere in it and none of the source or act values apply (none_of_these for both). The headline says a predictions-and-odds preview, which would have been one_of_several/media/predicts_his_fight had the body been saved.

Spanish interview with creator MMARC about his UFC history book; Topuria comes up as the figure behind MMA's growth in Spain. Centrality: the piece is about Marc and his book, but Topuria's importance gets several passages, so one_of_several is arguable. Act: Marc assesses Topuria's significance to the sport rather than his level, so none_of_these is the alternative.

Javier Mendez, Makhachev's coach, says Topuria needs more than one spectacular win before a Makhachev superfight and doubts his body suits welterweight. Source: Makhachev is only a talked-about superfight opponent, so other_fighter's coach is arguable. Act: the win-count condition is a steer; the welterweight doubt is an assessment. reports_his_next_fight: the writer's line that he is expected back no sooner than spring 2027 is unsourced and secondary, so no.

UFC.com feature ahead of Donchenko vs Soriano in Paris, almost entirely his quotes on his progress, his French, rankings and sponsors. Centrality: a fight preview covering both fighters is one_of_several by the guide, but Soriano gets only a short sketch, so main_subject. The Berggren knockout and TUF win are background; the closing results line is page furniture.

Spanish explainer: Dana White confirms Topuria is ready to return, no date or opponent set, Gaethje rematch and Pimblett named as options. he_speaks: his early-September comments are paraphrased, not quoted, so no. The Gaethje loss and Oliveira win are recapped as background.

Pimblett says nobody at the UFC has approached him about a rumoured December fight with Topuria, though he would take it; the piece retells their rivalry. Centrality: the guide says a fighter only rumoured against him does not count, so only_mentioned is arguable, but Topuria is half the story here. Act: denying the rumour is a factual update; the 'smash his head in' line is a callout. reports_his_next_fight: a denied rumour is thin news of his next fight. The article wrongly says he lost his featherweight belt to Gaethje.
